items.stem: Analyn can label the census boxes in 15 hours. Bea can do the same job in 10 hours. Working together, how long will they take?

reveal.terms: A "rate" is how much of the job gets done in one hour.
reveal.shortcut: Per hour, Analyn does 1/15 and Bea does 1/10. Together: 1/15 + 1/10 = 1/6. So the whole job takes 6 hours.
reveal.why_correct: 6 hours is right. Check: in 6 hours, Analyn does 6/15 and Bea does 6/10; together that is 1 whole job.

why_wrong.o1: This reads the combined rate (1/6 of the job per hour) as a time. It stops before turning the rate into hours.
why_wrong.o2: 25 hours adds the two times. Add the work done per hour, not the hours.
why_wrong.o4: 12.5 hours is the average of the two times. Together they must be faster than the faster person alone.

items.gen_sig: Analyn can label the census boxes in 15 hours. Bea can do the same job in 10 hours. Working together, how long will they take?
items.shortcut: For two workers, time together = product ÷ sum: (15 × 10) ÷ (15 + 10) = 150 ÷ 25 = 6 hours.
